titleZh: 专利转化运用：快马加鞭未下鞍
titleEn: Patent Commercialization: Accelerating Without Pause
sumZh: 以数据形式总结专利转化运用专项行动（2023—2025年）成效，指出首次完成全国2700多所高校院所134.9万件存量专利盘点、高校科研机构转让许可增长105.6%等成果，说明专利转化正成为培育新质生产力的关键引擎。
sumEn: Summarizes the achievements of the three-year patent commercialization campaign, including the first inventory of 1.349 million stock patents at universities and research institutes, arguing that patent commercialization has become a key engine for new quality productive forces.

titleZh: 专利转化运用：为培育发展新质生产力注入新动能
titleEn: Patent Commercialization: Injecting New Impetus into New Quality Productive Forces
sumZh: 聚焦破解专利转化'不能转、不愿转、不敢转、不会转、不便转'五大堵点，介绍通过职务科技成果赋权改革、开放许可、金融支持等举措推动专利从'书架'走向'货架'。
sumEn: Focuses on removing five major obstacles to patent transfer and introduces measures such as reform of job-related S&T achievement empowerment, open licensing, and financial support to move patents from shelves to production lines.

titleZh: 搭平台、建体系，专利转化运用生态日趋完善
titleEn: Building Platforms and Systems: A Maturing Patent Commercialization Ecosystem
sumZh: 阐释专利转化运用生态建设，指出以13家功能性平台为支撑、6家区域中心为纽带的全国运营平台体系已形成，开放许可声明达3.28万件、质押贷款超6000亿元，金融与服务体系日益健全。
sumEn: Explains the improving patent commercialization ecosystem, noting a national operation platform network backed by 13 functional platforms, 32,800 open-license declarations and over 600 billion yuan in pledge loans.

titleZh: 着力提升知识产权运用效益——访全国政协常委、国家知识产权局局长申长雨
titleEn: Improving IP Utilization Efficiency: An Interview with CNIPA Commissioner Shen Changyu
sumZh: 专访国家知识产权局局长申长雨，系统阐释加强知识产权转化运用对打通科技强、产业强、经济强路径的意义，并剖析转化运用市场导向不足、资源错配等短板及下一步长效机制建设方向。
sumEn: An interview with CNIPA Commissioner Shen Changyu on the significance of IP commercialization, analyzing weaknesses such as insufficient market orientation and proposing long-term mechanisms to improve conversion efficiency.

titleZh: 盘活专利存量 做大智造增量
titleEn: Revitalizing Patent Stock to Expand Smart Manufacturing Increment
sumZh: 报道重庆推进专利开放许可改革经验，通过'一对多'开放许可、大数据供需匹配和'先使用后付费'机制构筑'专利收储—精准推送—关联匹配—政策激励'闭环，累计实施开放许可备案近800件、达成许可超2800次。
sumEn: Reports Chongqing's patent open-licensing reform, which uses one-to-many licensing, big-data supply-demand matching and pay-after-use mechanisms to build a closed loop that has registered nearly 800 open licenses and over 2,800 license deals.

titleZh: 转化保护"双轮驱动" 布局维权"双向发力"
titleEn: Dual-Wheel Drive of Commercialization and Protection, Two-Way Effort in Layout and Rights Defense
sumZh: 解读《2025年中国专利调查报告》，援引马一德、宋河发、陶鑫良等专家观点，指出企业发明专利产业化率达54%、新兴产业专利正从'重数量'转向'重质量、重效益'。
sumEn: Interprets the 2025 China Patent Survey with expert views, noting the enterprise invention patent industrialization rate reached 54% and emerging industries are shifting from quantity to quality and efficiency.

titleZh: 高价值专利助力培育新质生产力
titleEn: High-Value Patents Help Cultivate New Quality Productive Forces
sumZh: 以OPPO折叠屏、脑机接口康复机器人等案例说明高价值专利推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合，指出截至2025年底国内高价值发明专利拥有量达229.2万件，'科研攻关—专利培育—产业应用'范式加快形成。
sumEn: Uses cases such as OPPO foldable phones and brain-computer interface robots to show high-value patents driving deep integration of technology and industry, noting 2.292 million high-value invention patents by end-2025.

titleZh: 奋进"十五五"推动知识产权事业高质量发展
titleEn: Advancing High-Quality IP Development in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
sumZh: 解读《知识产权保护和运用'十五五'规划》主要指标，展望每万人口高价值发明专利拥有量超22件、专利密集型产业增加值占GDP比重达14.6%等目标及高质量创造、高标准保护、高效益运用路径。
sumEn: Interprets the 15th Five-Year IP Plan indicators, looking ahead to targets of over 22 high-value invention patents per 10,000 people and patent-intensive industry value reaching 14.6% of GDP.

titleZh: 开放许可：让专利获得更广阔市场价值
titleEn: Open Licensing: Unlocking Broader Market Value for Patents
sumZh: 阐述专利开放许可'一对多'模式降低交易成本、放大转化收益的作用，指出截至2023年底22个试点省份5.9万余件专利参与试点、匹配推送至11万余家中小企业、达成许可超1.7万项。
sumEn: Explains how the one-to-many open-licensing model lowers transaction costs and amplifies returns, noting over 59,000 patents in 22 pilot provinces matched to 110,000 SMEs with 17,000 licenses reached by end-2023.

titleZh: 专利开放许可：促专利存量变转化增量
titleEn: Patent Open Licensing: Turning Patent Stock into Commercialization Increment
sumZh: 分析专利开放许可制度如何丰富中小企业技术供给、提升供需双方许可效率，援引曹新明观点指出该制度加快专利转化运用、实现由权利到收益的转变。
sumEn: Analyzes how the open-licensing system enriches technology supply for SMEs and improves licensing efficiency, citing scholar Cao Xinming that it accelerates patent commercialization from rights to returns.

titleZh: 开拓新时代高校专利转化运用新路径
titleEn: Opening New Paths for University Patent Commercialization in the New Era
sumZh: 中国工程院院士任其龙围绕'项目发现—评价审批—转化运营—作价增值'全链条解读专项行动方案，提出支持'科技成果+认股权'入股、健全尽职免责容错机制等高校专利转化新路径。
sumEn: Academician Ren Qilong interprets the commercialization campaign across the full chain from project discovery to value-added equity, proposing 'S&T achievement + equity warrants' and fault-tolerance mechanisms for university patents.

titleZh: 加快实现专利价值 赋能产业链创新
titleEn: Accelerating Patent Value Realization to Empower Industrial Chain Innovation
sumZh: 江苏大学知识产权学院院长唐恒提出从盘活高校存量专利、推进面向产业的专利转化、提升创新过程知识产权管理能力三个层面赋能产业链创新，建议重视存量专利背后的知识与能力溢出。
sumEn: Tang Heng proposes empowering industrial chain innovation through revitalizing university stock patents, industry-oriented patent conversion and improving IP management, emphasizing knowledge spillover behind stock patents.

titleZh: 强化专利转化运用，赋能重点产业提质强链增效
titleEn: Strengthening Patent Commercialization to Empower Key Industries
sumZh: 中国石化科技部副总经理王丽娟解读《关于推进重点产业知识产权强链增效的若干措施》，强调突出高质量专利创造、高水平产业化、专业化实施途径和全球性竞争合作。
sumEn: Wang Lijuan interprets the measures for strengthening key-industry IP, emphasizing high-quality patent creation, high-level industrialization, specialized implementation and global competition cooperation.

titleZh: 立足产业实际，推进重点产业知识产权强链增效
titleEn: Promoting Key-Industry IP Strengthening Based on Industrial Reality
sumZh: 国务院发展研究中心研究员王怀宇解读强链增效若干措施，指出其强调各层级协同、注重国际竞争与产业安全、顺应发展新趋势，推动专利链与创新链产业链深度融合。
sumEn: Wang Huaiyu interprets the key-industry strengthening measures, noting their emphasis on multi-level coordination, international competition and industrial security to deeply integrate patent, innovation and industrial chains.

titleZh: 推进知识产权转化运用，更好赋能高质量发展
titleEn: Promoting IP Commercialization to Better Empower High-Quality Development
sumZh: 中国科学院大学知识产权学院院长马一德提出完善知识产权转化法治保障、细化职务技术成果权益分配、围绕产业链布局知识产权密集型产业等系统建议。
sumEn: Ma Yide proposes systematic measures to improve the legal framework for IP commercialization, refine benefit distribution of job-related technical achievements and build IP-intensive industries around industrial chains.

titleZh: 强化知识产权增信功能，加速专利产业化进程
titleEn: Strengthening IP Credit Enhancement to Accelerate Patent Industrialization
sumZh: 河北经贸大学教授刘春霖论述强化知识产权增信功能以破解专利产业化资金链堵点，主张以专利高质量高价值提振资本市场信心、以精准服务便利投融资。
sumEn: Liu Chunlin argues that strengthening IP credit enhancement can unblock the financing bottleneck of patent industrialization by boosting capital-market confidence with high-value patents and convenient services.

titleZh: 全面拆解产业化过程，全域分析专利价值
titleEn: Deconstructing the Industrialization Process and Analyzing Patent Value Holistically
sumZh: 湖南省知识产权交易中心吴勤、甄彧介绍专利价值评估'全域分析法'，将专利产业化过程拆解为7个模块68项指标，从产业端、投资端视角识别专利转化前景以提升转化成功率。
sumEn: Wu Qin and Zhen Yu introduce the holistic patent valuation method that decomposes industrialization into 7 modules and 68 indicators, identifying conversion prospects from industrial and investment perspectives.

titleZh: 大力推进新能源产业知识产权转化运用
titleEn: Vigorously Promoting IP Commercialization in the New Energy Industry
sumZh: 宁德时代首席知识产权官孙明岩提出建设先进动力电池和储能产业链知识产权运营中心、开展产业链供应链知识产权协作、推进专利与标准结合等新能源领域专利转化路径。
sumEn: Sun Mingyan proposes building an IP operation center for the power battery and energy storage chain, supply-chain IP collaboration, and patent-standard integration to promote patent conversion in new energy.

titleZh: 用高水平转化运用支撑绿色能源化工产业高质量发展
titleEn: Supporting High-Quality Green Energy and Chemical Industry with High-Level Commercialization
sumZh: 王丽娟提出行业龙头企业应布局基础性前瞻性高价值专利、高标准建设绿色能源化工产业知识产权运营中心、深化职务发明三权改革以破解'不愿转、不会转、不敢转'。
sumEn: Wang Lijuan proposes that leading enterprises lay out high-value patents, build a green energy-chemical IP operation center and deepen job-invention rights reform to overcome reluctance, inability and fear of transfer.

titleZh: 发挥运营服务平台在专利转化运用中的关键作用
titleEn: Giving Full Play to the Key Role of Operation Service Platforms in Patent Commercialization
sumZh: 中国技术交易所董事长郭书贵提出加强运营平台能力建设、推进统一知识产权交易流程规范、优化数据资源共享与信息联合发布机制，建设互联互通的全国运营服务平台体系。
sumEn: Guo Shugui proposes strengthening platform capabilities, unifying transaction procedures and optimizing data sharing to build an interconnected national IP operation service platform system.

titleZh: 促进技术链接资本 提升企业专利转化能力
titleEn: Linking Technology with Capital to Improve Enterprise Patent Conversion
sumZh: 深圳证券交易所研究员王晓津论述区域性股权市场服务专利产业化、'科技成果+认股权'模式及高标准知识产权市场体系对企业专利转化的促进作用。
sumEn: Wang Xiaojin discusses how regional equity markets, the 'S&T achievement + equity warrant' model and a high-standard IP market system promote enterprise patent commercialization.

titleZh: 推动重点产业强链补链
titleEn: Strengthening and Supplementing Key Industrial Chains
sumZh: 中国科学院研究员宋河发提出建设科研项目专利导航机制、建立知识产权全过程管理和专员制度、布局标准必要专利、牵头建设专利池等推动重点产业强链补链的政策建议。
sumEn: Song Hefa proposes building patent navigation for R&D projects, whole-process IP management, standard-essential patent layout and patent pool construction to strengthen key industrial chains.

titleZh: 吹响专利成果转化的时代号角
titleEn: Sounding the Call of the Era for Patent Commercialization
sumZh: 上海大学教授陶鑫良解读专利转化运用专项行动方案，强调锚定全覆盖与高效率特色，提出在推进专利转移转化时应综合考量技术秘密、集成电路布图设计等其他创新成果权益。
sumEn: Tao Xinliang interprets the commercialization campaign, emphasizing full coverage and high efficiency, and urging comprehensive consideration of trade secrets and other innovation rights alongside patents.

titleZh: 让更多存量专利"奔赴"新质生产力！我国全面推进专利开放许可制度实施
titleEn: More Stock Patents Toward New Quality Productive Forces: China Fully Advances Patent Open Licensing
sumZh: 介绍专利开放许可制度全面落地后的实践案例与配套措施，援引马一德观点指出该制度核心在于解决专利许可供需不对称、降低交易成本，建议将符合市场需求的高价值专利进行开放许可。
sumEn: Introduces practice cases and supporting measures after full implementation of open licensing, citing Ma Yide that its core lies in solving supply-demand asymmetry and lowering transaction costs.

titleZh: 以开放许可促更多专利"落地生金"
titleEn: Using Open Licensing to Turn More Patents into Gold
sumZh: 评论指出专利开放许可通过'一对多'许可在供需间架桥，有利于盘活高校科研机构存量专利、促进中小企业创新，并提出需防范恶意专利布局等问题。
sumEn: A commentary arguing that open licensing bridges supply and demand through one-to-many licensing, helping revitalize university stock patents and promote SME innovation while guarding against malicious patent layout.

titleZh: 专利导航精准"指路" 产业发展追"高"逐"新"
titleEn: Patent Navigation Precisely Guiding Industries Toward Higher and Newer Development
sumZh: 以辽宁为例阐述专利导航通过分析全球1.7亿条专利情报为产业规划、企业培育提供决策建议，介绍绘制专利导航'地图'、建设13个导航服务基地等推动产业转型升级的实践。
sumEn: Using Liaoning as an example, explains how patent navigation analyzes 170 million global patent records to guide industrial planning, with a navigation map and 13 service bases driving industrial transformation.

titleZh: 激活专利"存量" 拉动市场"增量"
titleEn: Activating Patent Stock to Drive Market Increment
sumZh: 解读专项行动方案关于存量专利盘活的要求，援引孙国瑞、朱新远、王亚利等专家观点，提出存量专利分层差异化推送、强化校企合作实现高价值专利转化。
sumEn: Interprets the campaign's stock-patent revitalization requirements, citing experts on tiered differentiated patent push and strengthened university-enterprise cooperation for high-value patent conversion.

titleZh: 从司法判例解读职务发明认定要点
titleEn: Interpreting Key Points of Service Invention Determination Through Judicial Precedents
sumZh: 北京柳沈律所贾丽晨、刘国军结合最高法典型案例，从'执行本单位的任务'和'主要利用本单位物质技术条件'两方面剖析职务发明认定思路，指出'有关'相关性认定趋严的倾向。
sumEn: Liu Shen lawyers analyze service invention determination through Supreme Court cases on 'performing unit tasks' and 'mainly using unit material conditions', noting a stricter trend in relevance determination.

titleZh: 过去"不敢转" 现在"积极转"（科技视点·走进科技成果转化一线）
titleEn: From Afraid to Transfer to Actively Transferring: A Look at the Frontline of S&T Achievement Commercialization
sumZh: 深入报道职务科技成果赋权改革与单列管理改革成效，指出40家试点单位赋权成果超4000项、科研人员普遍可获70%以上转化收益，有效消除'不敢转'顾虑。
sumEn: Reports the effects of job-related S&T achievement empowerment and separate management reform, noting over 4,000 achievements empowered at 40 pilot units and researchers generally receiving over 70% of conversion proceeds.

titleZh: 《专利法实施细则》修改后关于职务发明奖酬新规的解读与合规建议
titleEn: Interpreting New Rules on Service Invention Rewards After the Patent Law Implementing Regulations Amendment
sumZh: 己任律所夏锋、杜晓宽、李琳虹解读新《专利法实施细则》提高职务发明奖酬法定标准、与《促进科技成果转化法》挂钩的变化，并从规章制度、受益人范围、标准合理性等维度提出合规建议。
sumEn: GEN Law lawyers interpret the higher statutory standards for service invention rewards after the Implementing Regulations amendment and provide compliance advice on rules, beneficiary scope and standard reasonableness.

titleZh: 人民网评：从"量"入"质"，知识产权赋能创新发展
titleEn: People's Daily Online Commentary: From Quantity to Quality, IP Empowers Innovation
sumZh: 人民网评指出我国知识产权正从数量扩张转向质量提升，2025年专利转让许可备案69.7万次、企业发明专利产业化率达54%，知识产权成为赋能实体经济的硬核资源。
sumEn: A People's Daily Online commentary noting China's IP shift from quantity to quality, with 697,000 patent transfer filings and a 54% enterprise invention patent industrialization rate in 2025.

titleZh: "浙"里发力，推动高价值专利产业化
titleEn: Zhejiang's Efforts to Promote High-Value Patent Industrialization
sumZh: 介绍浙江贯彻专利转化运用专项行动，通过推进专利导航、存量专利盘活、开放许可试点（9344件专利参与、5184件落地）和知识产权金融服务等推动高价值专利产业化。
sumEn: Introduces Zhejiang's implementation of the commercialization campaign through patent navigation, stock patent revitalization, open-licensing pilots (9,344 patents, 5,184 deployed) and IP finance services.

titleZh: 提升企业专利运营能力（专家观点）
titleEn: Improving Enterprise Patent Operation Capability (Expert Views)
sumZh: 汇集吕庭彦、秦元明、宋柳平等专家观点，认为专业化专利运营有助于推动高价值专利在产业层面广泛运用，我国高价值专利运营已进入新发展阶段。
sumEn: Collects expert views that specialized patent operation promotes broad industrial use of high-value patents and that China's high-value patent operation has entered a new development stage.

titleZh: 破解知识产权转化难题在于"贯通"
titleEn: The Key to Solving IP Commercialization Difficulties Lies in Connectivity
sumZh: 马一德在光明论坛指出破解知识产权转化难题关键在于贯通技术、专利、资本、市场和服务，以湖南大学电涡流阻尼技术从20万元转让费到亿元作价入股的案例说明机制变革的价值。
sumEn: Ma Yide argues the key to solving IP commercialization difficulties lies in connecting technology, patents, capital, market and services, citing Hunan University's case of turning 200,000 yuan licensing into 100 million yuan equity.

titleZh: 盘"存量"优"增量" 做好"盘活"大文章
titleEn: Revitalizing Stock and Optimizing Increment: The Big Task of Patent Activation
sumZh: 报道吉林、湖北、甘肃、新疆等地完成高校院所存量专利盘点工作，按照'边盘点、边推广、边转化'思路推动高校科研机构专利向现实生产力转化。
sumEn: Reports that Jilin, Hubei, Gansu and Xinjiang have completed stock patent inventories at universities, pushing their conversion under the 'inventory, promote and convert simultaneously' approach.

titleZh: 靶向发力，盘活高校和科研机构存量专利——专利转化运用专项行动经验谈
titleEn: Targeted Efforts to Revitalize University and Research Institute Stock Patents: Campaign Experience
sumZh: 总结专项行动中盘活高校科研机构存量专利的做法，指出实现134.9万件存量专利全覆盖盘点、筛选68万件可转化发明专利，并通过人工智能赋能、'双五星'专利精准盘活等构建长效机制。
sumEn: Summarizes the campaign's stock patent revitalization, noting full inventory of 1.349 million patents, screening of 680,000 convertible patents, and AI-empowered precision activation to build long-term mechanisms.

srcZh: 清华大学技术转移研究院
srcEn: Tsinghua University Institute of Technology Transfer
titleZh: 专家解读：盘活存量，做优增量，赋能经济社会高质量发展
titleEn: Expert Interpretation: Revitalizing Stock and Optimizing Increment to Empower High-Quality Development
sumZh: 清华大学技术转移研究院院长王燕解读存量专利盘活方案，提出以市场为导向建立筛选评估机制、打通供需信息堵点、以需求侧为导向开展订单式研发做优增量。
sumEn: Wang Yan interprets the stock patent revitalization plan, proposing market-oriented screening, unblocking supply-demand information and demand-driven R&D to optimize new patent increments.

titleZh: 员工发明专利创造效益2亿元只奖3个荣誉证，合不合理？
titleEn: Is It Reasonable to Reward a 200-Million-Yuan Invention with Only Three Honorary Certificates?
sumZh: 通过孙朝旭等案例揭示职务发明'一奖两酬'落实难问题，指出企业单方设定不合理的奖酬'约定'伤害发明人创新热情，新专利法明确了企业支付奖酬的法定义务。
sumEn: Reveals the difficulty of implementing service invention rewards through real cases, noting unreasonable employer-set terms harm inventor enthusiasm and the new Patent Law makes reward payment a legal obligation.

titleZh: 打通堵点，激发高校和科研机构专利转化动力
titleEn: Removing Obstacles to Stimulate Patent Commercialization at Universities and Research Institutes
sumZh: 介绍国家知识产权局系统优化专利政策、强化高校科研机构转化激励，通过职务科技成果赋权、资产单列管理和尽职免责容错机制破解'不敢转、不愿转、不会转'，夯实转化基础保障。
sumEn: Introduces CNIPA's systematic optimization of patent policies and stronger incentives for universities, using empowerment reform, separate asset management and fault-tolerance mechanisms to overcome transfer reluctance.

titleZh: 四链融合：走出象牙塔（之三）赋权改革唤醒"沉睡"专利
titleEn: Four-Chain Integration: Empowerment Reform Awakens 'Sleeping' Patents
sumZh: 以安徽大学王绍良团队极低温制冷机作价1005万元入股为例，报道安徽职务科技成果赋权改革实践，说明'赋权+转让+约定收益'模式让科研人员真正成为成果主人。
sumEn: Using Anhui University's cryogenic refrigerator case (10.05 million yuan equity), reports Anhui's job-related achievement empowerment reform where 'empowerment + transfer + agreed returns' makes researchers true owners.

titleZh: 《专利池建设运行工作指引》解读
titleEn: Interpreting the Guidelines for Patent Pool Construction and Operation
sumZh: 解读六部门《专利池建设运行工作指引》，阐释'一条主线、两个作用、三方兼顾、四项机制'总体思路，强调科学区分正当专利运营与专利权滥用、注重行业间利益平衡。
sumEn: Interprets the six-department patent pool guidelines, explaining its overall approach and emphasizing the distinction between legitimate patent operation and patent right abuse with industry interest balance.

titleZh: 《知识产权保护和运用"十五五"规划》解读：迈向知识产权强国的关键五年
titleEn: Interpreting the 15th Five-Year IP Plan: Five Key Years Toward an IP Powerhouse
sumZh: 李建征、吕冲系统解读'十五五'规划，指出知识产权从'量的积累'转向'质的跃升'、从'权利保护'转向'产业赋能'、从'国内体系'转向'全球治理'三大转向，并给出企业行动指南。
sumEn: A systematic interpretation of the 15th Five-Year IP Plan, identifying three shifts toward quality, industrial empowerment and global governance, with an action guide for enterprises.

titleZh: 导航指路 创新远航——推行专利导航与国家级审查资源下沉赋能产业创新
titleEn: Patent Navigation Guiding Innovation: Empowering Industrial Innovation with National-Level Examination Resources
sumZh: 报道东营推动专利导航与知识产权预警服务下沉研发一线，石大胜华依托专利导航优化研发路径预计缩短周期4个月、节约成本103万元，助力企业精准布局创新赛道。
sumEn: Reports Dongying's push of patent navigation and IP early-warning services into R&D, where Shida Shenghua's navigation-optimized R&D is expected to cut the cycle by 4 months and save 1.03 million yuan.

titleZh: 国家知识产权局2026立项名单透露信号：专利审查正进入AI治理时代
titleEn: CNIPA's 2026 Project List Signals Patent Examination Entering the AI Governance Era
sumZh: 知产力分析2026年度专利专项研究立项名单，指出超三分一项目聚焦AI、大模型进入审查质量管理、实用新型甄别等环节，专利审查正从'信息化辅助'进入'AI治理'时代。
sumEn: Zhichanli analyzes the 2026 patent research project list, noting over one-third focus on AI and large models entering examination quality management, signaling patent examination's shift to AI governance.

titleZh: 让"知产"变资产，促专利成红利（人民时评）
titleEn: Turning Intellectual Property into Assets and Patents into Dividends (People's Commentary)
sumZh: 人民时评指出专利开放许可作为制度创新有利于提升对接效率、降低交易成本，通过'一对多'许可拉近供需距离、放大转化收益，推动更多专利'下书架、上货架'。
sumEn: A People's Daily commentary arguing that open licensing, as an institutional innovation, improves matching efficiency and lowers costs, moving more patents from shelves to market.

titleZh: 专利开放许可让创新成果落地生金
titleEn: Patent Open Licensing Turns Innovation into Gold
sumZh: 中国科学院大学尹锋林论述专利开放许可可显著降低成果转化交易成本、增加转化成功机会，通过权威渠道发布可信交易信息解决供需信息不对称，助力盘活高校高价值存量专利。
sumEn: Yin Fenglin argues open licensing significantly lowers transaction costs and improves conversion success by publishing credible transaction information, helping revitalize high-value university patents.

titleZh: 大力促进知识产权价值实现
titleEn: Vigorously Promoting the Realization of IP Value
sumZh: 国家知识产权局局长申长雨在《求是》撰文，剖析'不能转、不愿转、不敢转、不会转、不便转'五类典型问题，提出深化权益分配改革、打通转化堵点、培育要素市场、推进强链增效等路径。
sumEn: CNIPA Commissioner Shen Changyu analyzes five typical obstacles to patent transfer and proposes deepening benefit-distribution reform, removing bottlenecks, cultivating factor markets and strengthening industrial chains.

titleZh: 【中国网评】从"半年45.3万件发明专利"看中国经济高质量发展逻辑
titleEn: China.com.cn Commentary: High-Quality Development Logic Behind 453,000 Invention Patents in Half a Year
sumZh: 肖宏伟评论认为高价值发明专利拥有量达236万件折射我国创新从'量'的积累到'质'的跃升，知识产权使用费出口额增长64.9%标志其正成为服务贸易'新名片'。
sumEn: Xiao Hongwei comments that 2.36 million high-value invention patents reflect a shift from quantity to quality, and a 64.9% rise in IP royalties exports marks IP as a new calling card for services trade.

titleZh: 人民论坛网评：让更多创新种子破土萌发
titleEn: People's Tribune Commentary: Let More Seeds of Innovation Sprout
sumZh: 评论认为高价值发明专利增量突破本质是创新导向从'数量追赶'向'质量深耕'的战略转向，知识产权制度通过严格保护与高效运用机制为创新种子培育提供沃土。
sumEn: A commentary arguing the growth of high-value invention patents reflects a strategic shift from quantity pursuit to quality cultivation, with the IP system providing fertile soil through strict protection and efficient use.

titleZh: 专利导航助推"双创融合"
titleEn: Patent Navigation Boosting Integration of S&T Innovation and Industrial Innovation
sumZh: 李晓帆、刘虹彤论述专利导航贯穿科研立项、实施、产出全过程精准引导创新，并通过产业发展方向、区域定位、发展路径三大模块系统支撑产业决策，推动科技创新与产业创新'双螺旋'发展。
sumEn: The authors argue patent navigation precisely guides innovation across R&D stages and supports industrial decision-making through three modules, promoting a double-helix of S&T and industrial innovation.
